## What's new
- Added a Reset all button that restores every setting to its default value. - Added support for dragging files from Finder or pasting files and images into the prompt as safely escaped paths.
## Changed
- Metalterm releases now run natively on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs from the same download. - Simplified the selected Appearance theme card to use its accent border without an additional “active” label. - Improved compatibility with terminal applications by advertising more supported capabilities while preserving the legacy terminal-name alias.
## Fixed
- Option-key characters and dead-key composition now follow non-US macOS keyboard layouts, with independent automatic, macOS, and Esc+ modes for each Option key. - Inline terminal apps that take over typing — Claude, Codex, REPLs, and similar — now reclaim the hidden input dock's space, with no fixed app list: the terminal detects them by behavior. - GNU `ls` now accepts Metalterm's generated color palette without errors or losing colored output. - Made the Appearance settings open and scroll smoothly by caching material previews outside the main drawing path. - Pasted text now appears in the pinned command line immediately. - Background terminal content continues updating correctly. - Command status colors remain correct when Zsh precmd hooks print additional output.
